author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects a PowerShell command line that both retrieves remote content and executes it in memory. The pairing matters: a download alone is ordinary, and Invoke-Expression alone is ordinary, but together they are the standard shape of a staged payload that never touches disk.
false_positives: Package bootstrap scripts such as the Chocolatey installer follow exactly this pattern. Allow-list by the specific URL host rather than by the technique.
name: PowerShell Download Cradle
query: ((process.name : "powershell.exe" or process.name : "pwsh.exe") and (process.command_line : "*DownloadString*" or process.command_line : "*DownloadFile*" or process.command_line : "*DownloadData*" or process.command_line : "*Invoke-WebRequest*" or process.command_line : "*Net.WebClient*" or process.command_line : "*iwr*" or process.command_line : "*curl*") and (process.command_line : "*IEX*" or process.command_line : "*Invoke-Expression*" or process.command_line : "*| iex*" or process.command_line : "*Start-Process*"))
